LESSON: USE OF SOCIAL MEDIA

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Morality and Social Media
Topic 6.1: Use of Social Media

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Use of Social Media. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should you use social media appropriately?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. list digital devices used at home and school,
2. discuss appropriate ways of using social media,
3. apply the value of integrity when using social media,
4. desire to do the right thing always even when no one is watching. The learner is guided to: devices that they know or use, use of social media, with strangers online, a gospel song or watch a video clip based on the Bible. Why should you use social media appropriately?

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. list digital devices used at home and school,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to list digital devices used at home and school,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. discuss appropriate ways of using social media,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to discuss appropriate ways of using social media,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. apply the value of integrity when using social media,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to apply the value of integrity when using social media,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. desire to do the right thing always even when no one is watching. The learner is guided to: devices that they know or use, use of social media, with strangers online, a gospel song or watch a video clip based on the Bible. Why should you use social media appropriately?
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to desire to do the right thing always even when no one is watching. The learner is guided to: devices that they know or use, use of social media, with strangers online, a gospel song or watch a video clip based on the Bible. Why should you use social media appropriately?. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Use of Social Media.
2. Explain Use of Social Media to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: in groups, list some digital devices that they know or use,
4. Show that you can: list digital devices used at home and school,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Use of Social Media. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why should you use social media appropriately?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In groups, list some digital devices that they know or use,
2. In pairs, discuss appropriate use of social media,

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. list digital devices used at home and school,
2. discuss appropriate ways of using social media,
3. apply the value of integrity when using social media,
4. desire to do the right thing always even when no one is watching. The learner is guided to: devices that they know or use, use of social media, with strangers online, a gospel song or watch a video clip based on the Bible. Why should you use social media appropriately?

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
